 SALINE COUNTY, Ark. (KATV) — Early voting in four Saline County runoff elections is scheduled to begin Nov. 24, with election day set for Dec. 1. 
 The runoff elections include the following races:
 Alexander City Council – Ward 4, Position 2 
 Trevis Bentley
 Council Member Juanita Wilson
 Benton City Council – Ward 1, Position 1 
 Preston Madison
 Council Member Frank Baptist
 Benton City Council – Ward 3, Position 1 
 Council Member Chad Slaughter
 Jana Hogue
 Haskell Mayor 
 Ray Garner
 Mayor Clyde Crookham
 Early voting will be available Tuesday through Friday only at the Benton Vote Center from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. The center will be closed on Thanksgiving.
 On Election Day, voters can cast their ballots from 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. Polling locations vary by race:
 Alexander City Council Race: 
 Alexander Community Center #2, 14577 Highway 111, Alexander
 Benton City Council Races: 
 Benton Vote Center, 221 N. Main Street, Benton
 Haskell Mayor Race: 
 Haskell Fire Department, 121 Cardinal Drive, Haskell
 Voters who want to vote absentee or determine whether they are eligible to do so should contact the Saline County Clerk's Office at (501) 303-5630.
 Election results will be posted after 7:30 p.m. on election night. You can find the results on KATV.com or by clicking here .
